editorial.blurb: A welcoming Vietnamese bakery café serving authentic banh mi, pho, and standout Vietnamese coffee in a clean, spacious setting.
editorial.insiderTip: Ask the staff to add extra paste or sauce to your banh mi sandwich if you prefer it less dry—they're accommodating with customizations.

topDishes.note: Amazing and hits the spot for Vietnamese coffee lovers
Meaty, flavorful, and more authentic than nearby Vietnamese spots
Light and well-balanced, just as expected
